statement: Almost-linear approximation of edit distance. For every fixed rational $`\varepsilon\in(0,1)`$, gives a randomized $`(1+\varepsilon)`$ approximation to unit-cost edit distance in worst-case expected time $`N^{1+o(1)}`$, with success probability at least 2/3. The strings have total length N and polynomially bounded integer symbols. This is an asymptotic guarantee at fixed accuracy.
